content.text: {"openings":[{"text":"On the sunny rooftop, Mina wanted a graceful kite flight, Pip wanted a daring dragon flourish, and Tavi wanted to be included in a surprise. Then Mina opened the little wooden tube.","when":[]},{"text":"Bright scraps waited beside the paper kite while three friends imagined three different kinds of hello. Mina lifted the tube’s lid to find out what the kite would carry.","when":[]}] ,"scenes":[{"scene":"read_label","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina opened the wooden tube and read the label aloud. “This hello is for {phrase:tube.label}!” she said, blinking at the unexpected name.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"tell_pip_label","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina found Pip beside the worktable. “The tube says {phrase:tube.label},” she told him. Pip’s little smoke-puff curled into a question mark.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"tell_tavi_label","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tavi leaned close, still guarding the secret in his enormous imagination. Mina showed him the label: “It says {phrase:tube.label}, not a birthday surprise.”","when":[]}]},{"scene":"tavi_blurts_secret","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tavi puffed out his cheeks. “A birthday surprise needs a huge audience!” he announced, accidentally telling everyone that he had been planning something enormous.","when":[{"key":"tube.label","op":"eq","value":"garden_birds","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tavi_learns_truth","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"When Tavi saw the words {phrase:tube.label}, his grand secret shrank into a sheepish smile. “Oh,” he said. “Then the birds should get the first hello.”","when":[{"key":"tavi.trust","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"give_tube_pip","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina placed the tube in Pip’s careful claws. “Keep it safe and keep the flight gentle.” Pip tucked it close, as if it were a sleeping beetle.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"give_tube_tavi","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina handed Tavi the tube. Tavi held it with both hands and nodded solemnly. “No giant birthday announcement,” he promised. “Only the right kind of hello.”","when":[]}]},{"scene":"give_bell_tavi","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Mina passed Tavi the brass bell, and he gave it one tiny test jingle.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"tie_bell","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tavi tied the bell beneath the kite’s nose. Its {phrase:bell.tone} note made the paper wings shiver with excitement.","when":[{"key":"kite.bell","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"attach_tail","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina chose the {phrase:scraps.color} scrap and fastened it into a long tail. “A steady tail for a steady hello,” she said.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"attach_dragon_fin","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Before Mina could say “perhaps not,” Pip clipped on a dragon fin. The kite suddenly looked ready to sneeze fire and chase the moon.","when":[{"key":"kite.fin","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"quiet_agreement","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip glanced at the tube, then at Mina’s careful tail. “I can fly quietly,” he said. “Quietly can still be splendid.” His smoke puff became a tiny silver star.","when":[{"key":"pip.agreement","op":"eq","value":"quiet_helper","at":"after"}]},{"text":"“No roaring dragon tricks?” Pip asked. Mina shook her head. Pip sighed theatrically, then smiled. “Very well. I shall be the world’s gentlest dragon messenger.”","when":[{"key":"pip.agreement","op":"eq","value":"quiet_helper","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"dragon_agreement","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina studied the proud fin. Pip held his breath. At last Mina gave one careful nod. “One dragon flourish.” Pip’s grin grew so wide that a smoke ring escaped.","when":[{"key":"pip.agreement","op":"eq","value":"performer","at":"after"}]},{"text":"“If the kite is going to be a dragon,” Mina said, “let it be a magnificent one.” Pip bowed to the paper wings, which immediately wobbled like dancing noodles.","when":[{"key":"pip.agreement","op":"eq","value":"performer","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"test_smooth","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The kite rose in a calm little arc. Pip held the tube close while Mina guided the string, and the paper tail traced a neat blue-gold-red smile across the sky.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"smooth","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"test_bird_signal","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The kite lifted above the garden. Its bell rang a bright or low little song, and Tavi waved the tube as proudly as a tiny parade marshal.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"ringing_signal","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"test_dragon_dance","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The fin caught the air. The kite swooped left, looped right, and performed a dragon dance so grand that Pip nearly applauded himself.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"dragon_dance","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"smoke_puff","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Pip added one neat smoke ring, shaped like a surprised dragon wearing a crown.","when":[{"key":"pip.wants","op":"eq","value":"dragon_message_ready","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"launch_kite","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina ran three steps and released the kite. Up it climbed, tugging the spool toward the bright blue sky.","when":[{"key":"kite.launched","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"grandma_response","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The smooth kite settled beside Grandma, its paper tail fluttering like a tiny flag. Pip’s quiet hello had arrived without waking a single sleeping pigeon.","when":[{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"Grandma","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"bird_response","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The bell rang over the garden, and the birds answered with a ridiculous chorus: cheep-cheep, squawk, and one very serious “boing!”","when":[{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"garden_birds","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"cloud_dragon_response","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The message arrived beneath Pip’s smoky dragon shadow. The kite looped once more, as if the clouds themselves had requested an encore.","when":[{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"cloud_dragon","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Pip’s fin flashed against the sun, and the cloud dragon received its message under a grand, wiggly dragon silhouette.","when":[{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"cloud_dragon","at":"after"},{"key":"pip.agreement","op":"eq","value":"performer","at":"after"}]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"The kite rested beside Grandma, its tail whispering against the rooftop while Pip’s careful claws held the empty string.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"smooth","at":"after"},{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"Grandma","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Far below, Grandma waved. Above her, the kite’s little paper tail made one graceful bow.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"smooth","at":"after"},{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"Grandma","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The garden birds answered the ringing bell with a chorus so silly that Tavi laughed until he had to sit on the worktable.","when":[{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"garden_birds","at":"after"},{"key":"kite.bell","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"The brass bell kept jingling over the garden, while three birds hopped in a row as if they were applauding with their feet.","when":[{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"garden_birds","at":"after"},{"key":"kite.bell","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Pip’s fin caught the sun, the kite looped beneath its smoky dragon shadow, and the cloud dragon’s hello sailed into the blue.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"dragon_dance","at":"after"},{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"The kite danced a dragon’s wobbly victory above the roof. Pip bowed so deeply that his last smoke ring landed on his own nose.","when":[{"key":"kite.flight_style","op":"eq","value":"dragon_dance","at":"after"},{"key":"pip.agreement","op":"eq","value":"performer","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Tavi stood beside Mina and Pip, all three shadows holding one string while the message glided toward the garden birds.","when":[{"key":"tavi.trust","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"eq","value":"garden_birds","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Three shadows stretched across the roof—one careful, one scaly, one small—as the kite carried its true hello away.","when":[{"key":"tavi.trust","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"tube.delivered_to","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"}]}],"lexicon":[{"key":"tube.label","value":"Grandma","text":"Grandma"},{"key":"tube.label","value":"garden_birds","text":"the garden birds"},{"key":"tube.label","value":"cloud_dragon","text":"the cloud dragon"},{"key":"scraps.color","value":"blue","text":"blue"},{"key":"scraps.color","value":"gold","text":"golden"},{"key":"scraps.color","value":"red","text":"red"},{"key":"bell.tone","value":"bright","text":"bright"},{"key":"bell.tone","value":"low","text":"low"}]}
